ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT COMMISSION AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY, JUNE 3, 2026
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 3:00 PM

Vivian Shimoyama, Chair  Nima Novin, Commissioner
John Thomas, Vice Chair  Andy Perez, Commissioner
Erica Jacquez, Commissioner  Jayro Sandoval, Commissioner
Austin Metoyer, Commissioner  Robert Smith, Commissioner
Miles Nevin, Commissioner  Brenda Wunsch, Commissioner
Kevin Noertker, Commissioner

  Members of the public have the option to email public comments to
  econdevcommission@longbeach.gov

  To view the meeting from your computer, tablet, or smartphone
  visit: https://longbeach.primegov.com/public/portal?fromiframe=true

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-55222 Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Economic Development
  Commission meeting of Wednesday, May 6, 2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-55230 Recommendation to receive and file a presentation from the Office of Ethics and
  Transparency regarding updates to the Ethics program.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  26-55233 Recommendation to receive and file a presentation from the Office of the City
  Attorney regarding the Brown Act.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  26-55224 Recommendation to receive and file a presentation on the Revolving Loan Fund
  Program, and, if appropriate, adopt the updated Economic Development
  Administration (EDA) Revolving Loan Program Administrative Plan for the City of
  Long Beach.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  26-55223 Recommendation to receive and file Executive Director’s Report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

Opportunity to address the Economic Development Commission on non-agenda items. Each
speaker is limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Rosa Garibay, City Clerk Assistant, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours prior
to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact (562) 570-5503.
